description: Seven searches cover broad English and Khmer terms, garment labor, provincial land issues, and specific protest leads. Two land petition events are supported, and the monk-march results remain a distinct follow-up lead. Searches have not yet systematically covered all March windows, provinces, or Khmer-local labor, land, student, religious, women’s and public-sector reporting.
required_followup: Continue feasible local-language and English searches across remaining March windows and sectors; distinguish actual local crowds from membership/affected-family counts and separate events by date/site.

description: Sources establish petition activity for the seven Siem Reap communities on/over 27–28 March and a distinct gathering on 29 March, but do not explicitly establish when either action ended or whether related public action continued afterward.
required_followup: Search permitted local reports/community updates for explicit closure or subsequent public activity; keep end dates unknown without evidence.

description: ADHOC’s 1 March press release announced an 8 March Freedom Park event planned for 500 and stated demands to government. RFA later documents about 20 activists outside the Thai Embassy with a different foreign-state demand, but neither opened account establishes whether the separately planned Freedom Park event occurred or its actual attendance.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous 8 March event-outcome account from the organizers or a permitted local outlet. Do not convert the announced 500, or an unrelated AP photo caption, into observed attendance.
